summary: Slice 1 of 5 (backend/core) of revision 3. Extended the existing Files explorer core (src-tauri/src/features/explorer/mod.rs) with the four R9 file operations as plain functions: create_item, rename_item, move_item and delete_item (delete_item_with takes an injectable Recycle Bin step). They share one validation and refusal path: empty/whitespace/over-long/Windows-invalid names are refused, name clashes are refused without overwriting, moving a folder into itself or a descendant is refused, a move between drives is refused before any file-system call, and delete only ever delegates to the Recycle Bin and refuses rather than deleting permanently. Added thin Tauri command shells in the same explorer feature (explorer_create/explorer_rename/explorer_move/explorer_delete) that run on a blocking worker; rename/move return ExplorerOp with repaths, delete returns ExplorerOp with closed tab ids. Added Store::repath_prefix and Store::close_prefix to the existing editor store (src-tauri/src/editor.rs): repath keeps unsaved buffers and re-points every open file at or under the old path (component-wise, case-insensitive matching), close_prefix closes a deleted file's or folder's tabs, binning unsaved text. Registered the four commands and made editor/model public in lib.rs for the integration tests. Added the trash 5.4.0 crate to Cargo.toml for Recycle Bin deletes. Added the executable flag to the Rust TerminalDef with serde default true and a manual Default keeping it true (R11 core model). A6 version bump (2.3.0) is deliberately left to the version-bump slices: bumping only Cargo.toml here would break the one-version-everywhere check, so all three version files stay at 2.2.0 in this slice. Tests: 17 in src-tauri/tests/explorer_ops.rs, 7 in src-tauri/tests/editor_repath.rs, and one R11 model unit test. cargo check --tests, both new test binaries, the explorer integration test, and the model/editor/config unit tests pass; cargo clippy --all-targets reports no warnings in the changed files; npm run build succeeds. Note: an accidental crate-wide rustfmt was fully reverted so only in-scope files are modified. Slice 2 of 5: R11 backend filtering and Rust tests, the explorer file-operation API and UI (R9, A1, A2), plus the targeted folder reload it needs. Added AppDef::executable_terminals() (serde default true) and made start_all/stop_all iterate it, with four R11 integration tests. Added explorerApi.create/rename/move/remove and the ExplorerOp/ExplorerRepath types, with API tests asserting the command names and arguments. Added ExplorerDialogs (create/rename/delete prompts on the shared responsive Dialog, with the delete prompt naming the item, saying a folder's contents go with it and folding in the unsaved-changes warning) and validateExplorerName mirroring the core's A2 checks. Added useExplorerOps, which runs one operation at a time, shows a busy state, surfaces the core's refusal message and re-reads the true state on failure, applies the returned repaths/closed tab ids through an injected editor bridge, flushes pending typing before a delete, and refreshes only the affected folder levels. Extended useExplorer with reloadFolder (root or one expanded child, leave others alone) and forgetUnder (drop the cached subtree under a renamed/moved/deleted item). Extended ExplorerPanel with a wrapping New file/New folder/Rename/Move/Delete toolbar, row selection, HTML5 drag-and-drop onto folders with a Move-button alternative, drag self/descendant refusal, and the dialogs; the tree and existing open path behave exactly as before when no editor bridge is supplied. No App/useEditor wiring (slice 4); that slice must pass a memoised editor bridge or the FileRow memo is defeated. Ran npm run lint, npm run build, the full npm test suite (576 pass), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings, rustfmt on the new test, and the touched Rust tests. Slice 3 of 5. Wired the explorer's file operations into the editor and App and finished the R9 tests for the operation hook and dialogs. useEditor now exposes flushPending (awaits pending typing snapshots before a delete, A4), applyRepaths (re-points open tabs after rename/move so the path-derived tab groups recompute, A3), applyClosed (drops tabs the core already closed and binned, then reloads the bin, A4) and dirtyTitlesUnder (titles of unsaved tabs at or under a path, folded into the one delete prompt, R9). App passes a memoised editor bridge to ExplorerPanel so the explorer toolbar and drag-and-drop are enabled without defeating the memoised file rows, and its reset key now follows the resolved root rather than the active path so a rename under the same root does not throw away the tree. App also filters AppHeader's states and F5 by the new pure isExecutable helper (TerminalDef.executable defaults to on; newTerminal sets it), shows a dismissible brief 'No executable terminals' notice when Start all or F5 has nothing executable (A5/R11), and puts the real F5 hint on the palette Start all / Stop all entries while Refresh everything keeps 'No shortcut' (R12). Added ExplorerDialogs.test.tsx and useExplorerOps.test.tsx, extended useEditor.test.tsx and App.explorer/App.shortcuts with App-level R9/R11/A5/R12 proofs. Existing App tests that matched the now-duplicated Delete/New file labels were scoped to their dialog or to the editor's own New control. npm run lint, npm run build and the full Vitest suite (619 tests, 53 files) pass. Slice 4/5 of revision 3: finished the remaining R11 window-side pieces and verified the parts already committed. HomeScreen's card now filters app.terminals through isExecutable before computing rollup, appButton and the running count, so a non-executable terminal never turns the status dot green or flips the card to Stop all, while an app whose terminals are all non-executable still shows its Start all state; running consoles keep counting for Stop all as before. Added R11 coverage to model.test.ts (newTerminal().executable defaults to true; isExecutable treats a missing saved flag as executable and only an explicit false as off) and to HomeScreen.test.tsx (non-executable running does not go green/Stop; executable running does; all-non-executable keeps Start). Verified the already-present slice parts: AppTests, AppExplorerTests (R9 rename/delete tab integration), AppShortcutTests (R11/F5/A5 notice and R12 palette F5 hint) and AppFeatureTests all pass, plus the Rust integration tests: explorer_ops 17, editor_repath 7 and terminal_executable 4 tests pass. npm run lint, npm run build and the full vitest suite (624 tests, 53 files) all pass. No out-of-scope files were touched; the only app files changed in this slice are src/features/home/HomeScreen.tsx, src/features/home/HomeScreen.test.tsx and src/state/model.test.ts. Slice 5 of 5. Wired the R11 executable flag through the remaining UI: the Sidebar app status dot now counts only executable terminals (matching Start all / Stop all and F5), and EditPane has a labelled executable checkbox per terminal whose value draft() always writes (an old config with no flag saves as executable). Added the R10 mobile-first pass to CommandPalette.module.css: the base now fills the width, sits at the top and is bounded by 100dvh so the on-screen keyboard cannot squeeze the list, with a @media (min-width: 640px) block restoring the current 12vh / min(560px,100%) / 60vh centred palette. Bumped the app version to 2.3.0 in package.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json and src-tauri/Cargo.lock, plus the package-lock.json entry and the two tests that assert the shipped version (App.test.tsx footer and App.version.test.tsx); package-lock.json and App.version.test.tsx are needed to keep the version suite green although the design scope did not list them. Added R11/R10 tests and left the already-built R9 explorer ops untouched. Verified (version files are kept in step; the version assertion test is not a feature requirement): npm run lint, npm run build, full npm test (634 pass), cargo clippy -D warnings, and cargo tests explorer_ops/editor_repath/terminal_executable.
